title: Protocol Canary fixture (schema_version 1)
description: A single compatibility-assertion fixture consumed by StellarCanary/Protocol-Canary's canary-fixtures loader. This schema mirrors that implementation (see Protocol-Canary's docs/fixture-contract.md); it is a convenience for editor/CI linting in this repository, not an independent specification. On any disagreement, Protocol-Canary's implementation is authoritative.

id.description: Unique across every fixture loaded from a given --fixtures-dir, not just within this file. Convention (not enforced by the loader): p<protocol>-<surface>-<slug>.

protocol.description: The Stellar protocol version this fixture targets. A run whose --protocol does not match is skipped, not failed.

surface.description: Selects which surface crate parses the fixture body. Any other value fails to parse.

category.description: Free-text grouping, e.g. a CAP slug ("cap-0083") or "network"/"smoke". Avoid vague values such as misc/other/test/general.

source_reference.description: An authoritative upstream reference: a CAP identifier/URL, an upstream XDR definition, or an official release/API doc URL. Strongly expected for any protocol-specific fixture.

required_capabilities.description: kebab-case canary_core::Capability values. A fixture requiring a capability the target project lacks is skipped, not failed.

input_file.description: Path to an externally stored input file, relative to this fixture file's own directory. Existence is checked by the validator; the loader does not read the file's contents itself.

expected_file.description: Path to an externally stored expected-output file, relative to this fixture file's own directory.

type.description: The XDR type name canary-xdr should decode value_base64 as.
